note: The Godthrone kit's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md). Keys are the kit's MAT slots (50-biome-godthrone-species.js, BIO.libSwap) and the host's ground slots (84-host-ground.js: KGROUND.layer and hostGroundLib). Station 1 (the summit vent, 2026-10-26): the halo's beads are KGROUND's sand kind over ground.beads.orange (the Moon's orange soil) and ground.sand.black (the crystallised beads), full colour; the pit's glassy floor ground.obsidian and the spatter ground.scoria, full colour; groundDetail a grey multiply (ground.cinder); rockFace the titanium basalt's grain on every face, grey under KSTRATA's tibasalt colours (rock.basalt.titanium, delivered 2026-10-27, wired 2026-11-04 in place of the rock.basalt.flowbanded stand-in); rock the talus blocks and stones (the same titanium grain, grey under the instance's near-black); bomb the bombs' and the spatter's glass skin (ground.lava.crust, grey); lavaCrust the throat's crust grain (fx/lava's crust); hair Pele's hair (card.pele.hair, a 3x3 sheet: one mat a card, the middle cell); portal the sealed portal's white render (concrete.ancient). Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/godthrone after any change, then python3 build.py. The new stations' sets (2026-11-04; each page takes only those its station.json "tex" names, build.py BASE_TEX): rockTafoni (rock.tafoni: the orange belt's cliff faces), palagonite (rock.palagonite: the altered glass on the ground), iceDebris (ice.debris: the debris-covered tongues), lichenCrust (ground.lichen.crust: the crusts), rockMega (rock.megabreccia: the rim's faces under KSTRATA's megabreccia), pavement (ground.pavement.desert: the rim's regolith), iceGlacier (ice.glacier), iceRust (ice.rust: the bloodfalls' stained ice), rustTerrace (ground.rust.terrace: the seep's terraces), riverweed (ground.riverweed.red: the blood river's weed), ferroCrust (mineral.crust.ferromanganese: the Red Gills' rust collar, delivered for it and wired here), tuff (rock.tuff) and ash (ground.ash: the downwind ash beds), rockColumns (rock.columnar: the scarp's colonnades, the tube's ilmenite columns).
